head: Samsung Keyboard may clean up your voice typing, like Pixel's Rambler
dek: A One UI 9.5 test build has a Samsung Keyboard setting called Refine Voice Input that removes filler words and hesitations, with the text appearing after you finish speaking, SamMobile found.
details: It works like Rambler on the Pixel 11, which Google hasn't brought to other phones yet. Samsung's version seems to process your message automatically. Samsung hasn't announced One UI 9.5.
where: Galaxy phones, One UI 9.5, not announced
means: Voice messages on a Galaxy may come out cleaner without editing.
